notes.title: A Spooky Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there ghoulish bips[/h3]

I had the [i]totally original[/i] idea of doing a festive halloween update, and it's here just in time!

[h2]The Spooky Dungeon?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38842833/c1f3214e4182b16dc7582deaa86813784904a5b3.png[/img]
I'm experimenting with ways to get more content out to you faster. The first of these is a new "Spooky Dungeon" map that I totally didn't just take off an asset store and slap some golf holes inside.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38842833/69d09b56fbe9aafb17195b8a66726a0a47a0b4e7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38842833/464ad511729443049a0265766f894220e8ce676f.png[/img]

I'm also practicing an "iterative" approach here, which is code for "rush 9 holes out as quickly as possible and then wait for you lovely folks to tell me what to fix 😬"

[h2]New cosmetics![/h2]

To go along with the spooky map are some fun new hats too:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/82RRnVtftxcW8SR2jg/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Try not to be scared of things that go bip in the night[/i]
Matt
aka Mr Spooks

notes.title: The Dead Game Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello my bippers[/h3]

It's been far to long since the last update and I have nothing to blame except stupid "real life" getting in the way of bip-dev.

[h2]Is this game dead?[/h2]
Absolutely not! Just being made very slowly in my evenings and weekends. Some recent life events (👶) have rather disrupted my ability to spend entire weekends bippin'.


[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]

Got some pretty big changes to how the controls work in this update

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZXuD4ot5L847en39KP/source.gif?cid=790b7611a158272fe96fd285eea1fd28c7bf0da8ec3b9d3a&rid=source.gif&ct=g[/img]

I've tried to make things more streamlined:

[list]
[*] The status of all of your abilities are now visible in the HUD.
[*] They all have cooldowns that can be changed in the Lobby Settings.
[*] Pressing R will now take you back to where you were the last time you hit the ball (in bounds), F will no longer take you back to where you spawned.
[*] You don't have to wait until you've slowed down before you can hit your ball again, you just have to wait for the cooldown.
[/list]

[h2]One more thing[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KChH7N7qhuQ8cFczFb/source.gif?cid=790b76114a379e11986aa439cfb4f79c8b0d11318805680c&rid=source.gif&ct=g[/img]

You can jump!


[i]Don't stop bip-lievin[/i]
Matt
